en: Colored vintage postcard view of a broad boulevard with tram tracks and several trams, lined with multi‑story buildings on the left and a formal garden square on the right. Dominating the right side is a large neoclassical building with a wide staircase and a colonnaded portico, likely a museum, facing a park with statues and paths. The sky is softly tinted and the card shows aging spots and a central crease. At the top is printed multilingual text identifying the location as Museum Boulevard in Budapest.
